capability_signals: Task bars with dependencies and progress

classification.verdict: REJECT as replacement for the countdowns.html Gantt; REFERENCE_ONLY as a library

integration_constraints: bars only where both instants are recorded; never invent spans
re-evaluate only if a future need is an editable/planning Gantt where viewer-local timezone and date-level granularity are acceptable

observed_facts.elapsed_shading: approximable via the task progress field (manually computed), and readonly mode can disable its drag/resize editing surface; neither offsets the blockers above
observed_facts.instant_fidelity: feed instants are sub-day precise with PT offsets (e.g. closes 2026-11-08T15:00:00-08:00). Frappe Gantt is date-first: an end at exactly midnight is extended to 23:59:59 ('last day is full day', src/index.js) and view headers/formats are date-level (YYYY-MM-DD). Boundary instants would be moved or visually rounded — span-invention risk against the bars-only-from-recorded-instants rule
observed_facts.milestones: NO native milestone type: code search for 'milestone' in frappe/gantt = 1 hit (demo index.html only). Every task requires an end (src/index.js: a task without end is console.error'd and dropped). opens=null entries would need a fabricated start (=closes) and would render as a zero/sliver bar, not the current diamond milestone — a misrepresentation
observed_facts.no_build_step: passes only via CDN UMD (cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/frappe-gantt/dist/frappe-gantt.umd.js + css) or a vendored dist file; countdowns.html is currently zero-dependency and the seed constraint is do-not-vendor-source, so CDN is the only route — an external runtime dependency the current page does not have
observed_facts.pt_calendar_axis: NOT ACHIEVABLE: all date math is browser-local (src/date_utils.js parse() builds new Date(...vals) in local time; no timezone option exists — language only). The timeline anchors at start_of(range minimum, view unit) and steps 7d from there; weekly gridlines cannot be pinned to America/Los_Angeles calendar midnights, and output varies with the viewer's timezone. The current hand-rolled chart does PT-midnight, DST-aware weekly ticks (PR #2129)
observed_facts.scoped_answer: No. Milestones for null opens are not representable without fabricating a start, and the PT-calendar axis cannot be pinned (browser-local dates, range-anchored steps). Two of the three stated requirements fail at the library's core date model, not at configuration.
observed_facts.scoped_question: Can Frappe Gantt render the fleet's deadline-window view (bars only where both instants are recorded, milestones where opens is null, PT-calendar axis) from the challenge-countdowns-feed instants — replacing the hand-rolled SVG in countdowns.html without inventing spans and without a build step?
